bottom_line: Compared with placebo, apixaban 10 mg once daily increased ISTH major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding (hazard ratio, 2.45; 95% confidence interval, 1.31 to 4.61; P⫽0.005).
implications: In this phase 2 trial, adding apixaban to antiplatelet therapy increased major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding versus placebo (e.g., apixaban 10 mg once daily HR 2.45, 95% CI 1.31 to 4.61), while ischemic outcomes were numerically lower but not statistically significant (e.g., HR 0.61, 95% CI 0.35 to 1.04; P⫽0.07). These numbers support concluding increased bleeding risk and only a trend (not definitive proof) toward fewer ischemic events at the tested lower doses.
